runs.t: Composition builds behavior by combining focused collaborators, rather than relying on deep inheritance trees. It typically makes variation explicit and reduces coupling between features.

Model capabilities as strategies or services passed into an object. Prefer inheritance when a real subtype relation satisfies Liskov substitution and shared behavior is stable; use interfaces to express capabilities, not incidental family trees.
A report exporter can compose a formatter, storage destination, and delivery channel rather than inherit from BaseExcelEmailS3Report. Testing each variant becomes straightforward.
Composition can scatter behavior across too many objects, and indirection has a cost. Deep inheritance is not always wrong: framework extension points sometimes use it deliberately.
